_doc: Web2Lan overlay config. Edit this file and reload the page — no rebuild.
routes: map a public host (or path prefix) to an intranet target.
kind='host'   -> whole host goes to one target
kind='prefix' -> a path prefix on a host goes to one target
site.apiPrefixes  -> path prefixes the Service Worker tunnels (rest stays on nginx)
site.neverTunnel  -> path prefixes that must always hit the origin instead of the
tunnel. Matches on prefix boundaries: "/api/auth" covers
Leave this EMPTY to let authentication go through the tunnel:
the agent then logs in itself and keeps the session in its own
cookie jar, which is what makes business API calls travel P2P
instead of being replayed via the origin on every 401.
site.probePath    -> path used to verify the tunnel; any HTTP status counts as alive.
MUST fall under one of site.apiPrefixes, otherwise the SW never
intercepts it and the probe always reports 'tunnel down'.
signaling.stun    -> comma-separated STUN URLs ('' disables STUN)
